title: Catalogue import and export
subtitle: Add or update up to 200 products and services at once with an Excel file.
fileLanguage: The Excel file stays in French: keep the column headers and the suggested values (for example the condition “Neuf”, meaning new) exactly as they are in the template.
prepareDescription: The template contains the list of subcategory codes. Columns marked with an asterisk are required; a note on each header explains the expected format.
updateHint: To change your prices or stock: export, edit the file, then import it. Rows whose “Référence interne” (internal reference) matches one of your listings update its price, stock and alert threshold.
checkDescription: Checking saves nothing. New products are created as drafts: review them, then publish them.

errorLinesHint: Rows with errors will be skipped: fix them in the file and check again, or import the others.
